description:
Senior Infrastructure Engineer (Network Infrastructure)

About EverOps

EverOps is the partner engineering teams wish they had but didn't know existed. We embed elite operators directly in our customers' teams to help them ship faster, reduce risk, and optimize cloud spend. We call them TechPods: forward-deployed, outcome-driven, backed by proven playbooks and AI-native workflows.

We sit in the sweet spot between strategy-only firms and staff-aug vendors. Not Big 4. Not bodies for hire. Operators who think big and deliver fast. Since 2012, companies like Coinbase, Snowflake, and Peloton have trusted us to scale platforms, cut waste, and modernize delivery.

We are an AWS Advanced Tier co-sell partner, and our go-to-market is increasingly AWS-led. Our thesis is sharp: make AI actually run in production on AWS, not in a slide deck. That is the work this role delivers.

EverOps has always been 100% remote. Our culture was built for a distributed team to thrive, and this role can be based anywhere in the United States.

The Challenge

We’re hiring a Senior Infrastructure Engineer with deep mastery in enterprise networking to lead critical network modernization work across our customer environments. This role will assess aging and inconsistent networks, drive hardware and architecture refreshes, harden security, and mature how networks are monitored and managed, using automation and infrastructure as code wherever possible.

The Mission

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you will join our U.S.-Based Virtual Operating Center, working within a dynamic team to own and evolve enterprise network infrastructure across multiple customer environments. Your primary mission will focus on assessing and modernizing network architecture, delivering secure and redundant designs, maturing monitoring and observability, and building automated, repeatable network operations.

You will be expected to lead by example - running network assessments and turning findings into clear remediation roadmaps, designing and executing site refreshes across switching, wireless, firewalls, and WAN circuits, building out monitoring with tools like LogicMonitor and Datadog, and driving network-as-code using Terraform, Ansible, and GitHub-based operations, while mentoring peers and establishing best practices to ensure scalable, secure, and repeatable network operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead design, implementation, and troubleshooting of enterprise network infrastructure (routing, switching, firewalls, VPN, SD-WAN, wireless)

  • Conduct network assessments across offices, data closets, and circuits; document findings and build prioritized remediation and refresh roadmaps

  • Plan and execute network refreshes and site builds, including BOM review, staging, cutover, and post-change validation

  • Design and tune enterprise wireless (Meraki, Juniper Mist, Aruba), including RF planning, channel and power optimization, and 5/6 GHz deployments

  • Administer and harden next-generation firewalls (Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, or similar), including policy, segmentation, and secure remote access

  • Design redundant, highly available architectures that remove single points of failure at every site

  • Own and mature network observability using LogicMonitor, Datadog, SNMP-based polling, and similar platforms

  • Build proactive monitoring, alerting, and dashboarding to drive faster detection and resolution of issues

  • Manage network configurations as code using Terraform, Ansible, and vendor APIs

  • Leverage GitHub (GitOps) for:

  • Source control of network configurations

  • Pull request-based change management

  • CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) for network deployments

  • Treat network changes as code with full traceability and rollback capability

  • Manage hybrid connectivity to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including VPN, VPCs, and transit gateways

  • Coordinate with ISPs, MSPs, and hardware vendors on circuits, support cases, and escalations

  • Support incident response and root cause analysis for network and infrastructure issues

  • Maintain documentation, diagrams, and runbooks reflecting current network state

You Have

  • 5+ years in network engineering, IT infrastructure, or IT operations

  • Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, routing (BGP, OSPF), switching, VLANs, firewalls, VPN, DNS, DHCP, wireless

  • Hands-on production experience with enterprise network platforms such as Cisco/Meraki, Juniper/Mist, Aruba, Palo Alto Networks, or Fortinet

  • Proven experience leading network assessments, hardware refreshes, or site builds end to end

  • Strong wireless experience, including site surveys, RF troubleshooting, and channel planning

  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as LogicMonitor, Datadog, and Dynatrace

  • Expert-level knowledge of SNMPv2 and SNMPv3, including MIBs, traps, polling architecture, and secure configuration

  • Strong scripting/automation skills (Python, PowerShell, or similar)

  • Experience with Terraform, Ansible (or equivalent IaC tools) in production environments

  • Experience using GitHub (or similar) for CI/CD and infrastructure automation

  • Experience with APIs and system integrations

  • Solid understanding of change management, incident management, and troubleshooting methodology

  • Ability to communicate findings and tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and non-technical leadership

Extra Awesome

  • Experience with cloud-managed networking dashboards and their APIs (Meraki Dashboard, Mist, Aruba Central)

  • Experience with SolarWinds or open-source NMS platforms (e.g., LibreNMS, Zabbix, Nagios)

  • Relevant certifications (CCNP, JNCIA/JNCIS, PCNSE, CWNA, or equivalent)

  • Experience with Panorama or Strata Cloud Manager

  • Experience with cloud networking constructs (VPCs, transit gateways, load balancers, peering)

  • Experience with Slack / ITSM tools (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow, Freshservice)

  • Familiarity with security frameworks (NIST, SOC2, CIS) and supporting penetration tests or audits

  • Experience building runbooks, playbooks, or automated remediation workflows

  • Experience using AI-assisted tools for network troubleshooting, config analysis, and documentation

  • Incident Response / Forensics awareness to assist with security-related investigations

Benefits

  • 100% Remote Workplace: We’ve been remote since Day 1!

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off.

  • Equity: Become a true owner of the company.

  • 401k with company contribution and sponsored healthcare.

  • Professional Growth: Access to training and certification programs to accelerate your career.
